title: MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update (PC) — EFHK Helsinki + LIRA Rome Ciampino Steal the Show!
description:
It’s April 11, 2026, and this week’s MSFS 2020 Marketplace Update (PC) is stacked with two absolute must-have airport pickups leading the charge: EFHK Helsinki-Vantaa and LIRA Rome Ciampino. If you love fresh routes, new approach challenges, and that “new scenery smell,” you’re in the right place. 😄
✈️ New airports added this week (PC)

The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:
🛫 MK-STUDIOS: EFHK Helsinki Vantaa (New on PC and Xbox)
🛫 FSDG: FMEP Reunion Saint-Pierre Pierrefonds (New on PC and Xbox)
🛫 SPINOZA: KBDR SIKORSKY MEMORIAL AIRPORT (New on PC and Xbox)
🛫 Voyager Sim Project: LIC1 Helipad San Michele (New on PC — PC-only release)
🛫 SimPixel: LIRA Rome Ciampino (New on PC and Xbox)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 AC Scenery: Bratislava Cityscape (New on PC and Xbox)
🌆 flyndrive4d: Greece Islands South Pack (New on PC — PC-only release)

If you want more MSFS 2020 marketplace update news and MSFS 2020 new addons, make sure to SUBSCRIBE and hit the bell! 🔔
